title: HDF Extension Primitives
description: Extension types for waivers, attestations, generators, and integrity.

expiration_date.description: The date when this waiver expires.

message.description: A message associated with the waiver.

run.description: Whether to run the requirement despite the waiver.

skipped_due_to_waiver.description: Indicates if the requirement was skipped due to this waiver.

Waiver_Data.description: Data associated with a waiver that exempts a requirement from assessment.
Waiver_Data.title: Waiver Data

Attestation_Status.description: The attested status of a requirement. Only 'passed' or 'failed' are valid for attestations.
Attestation_Status.title: Attestation Status

control_id.description: The ID of the requirement being attested.

frequency.description: How often this attestation should be reviewed. Example: 'annually', 'quarterly'.

updated.description: When this attestation was last updated.

Attestation_Data.description: Data for a manual attestation that overrides automated assessment results.
Attestation_Data.title: Attestation Data

name.description: The name of the tool that generated this file. Example: 'Chef InSpec'.

version.description: The version of the tool. Example: '5.22.3'.

Generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this HDF file.
Generator.title: Generator

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm used for the checksum.

signed_by.description: Identifier of who signed this file.

Integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying the HDF file has not been tampered with.
Integrity.title: Integrity
